name: Race NYC 2
summary:
New York never sleeps. Neither do its streets.

THE REAL MANHATTAN
The city outside your windows is built from real map data: about 20,000 real buildings at their real heights, the real shoreline and street grid, and the Brooklyn, Manhattan, Williamsburg and Queensboro bridges where they really stand. Lit windows show rooms inside, shops glow at street level, and Brooklyn, Queens and Jersey City shine across the rivers.

THE MANHATTAN LOOP
A 17 km lap: north up the FDR Drive under the bridges, down 42nd Str
